Name: CS_SHADOW_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Shadow map settings for each level of the Shadow Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 2.

Fields.Name: Shadows Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns shadows on for this level. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Maximum Filter Level
Fields.Description: Caps the shadow filter (softening) quality level; higher levels set by the scene are lowered to it. Retail: 0 Off and Low, 1 Medium, 2 High and Maximum.

Fields.Name: Resolution Multiplier
Fields.Description: Each shadow cascade's resolution = configured size × Multiplier ÷ Divider, then clamped between Minimum and Maximum Resolution. Retail: 1, 2 on Maximum.

Fields.Name: Resolution Divider
Fields.Description: Divides the configured shadow map resolution (see Resolution Multiplier). Retail: 4 Low, 2 Medium, 1 High and Maximum.

Fields.Name: Minimum Resolution
Fields.Description: Lowest shadow map resolution per cascade, in pixels. Retail: 128.

Fields.Name: Maximum Resolution
Fields.Description: Highest shadow map resolution per cascade, in pixels. Retail: 512 Low, 1024 Medium, 2048 High, 4096 Maximum.

Fields.Name: Blur Count Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the configured shadow blur count; 0 leaves it unchanged. Retail: -4 Low, -1 Medium, 0 High and Maximum.
